data.name: Gopi Bodhankar
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Gopi Bodhankar has made a big mark in cricket. With 25 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 37*, with an average of 10.53 and a quick strike rate of 96.24. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 1 sixes and 18 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 20.0 overs, taking 8 wickets at an economy rate of 8.45. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
